titre: Ventes de sachets de nicotine aux États-Unis
sous_titre: Ventes mensuelles en magasin, en millions de dollars, janvier 2023 et août 2025

Menthe.texte: Mint-flavored nicotine pouch dollar sales increased from $87.4 million to $308.9 million (+253.5%)

Autres arômes.texte: All other-flavored nicotine pouch dollar sales increased from $32.7 million to $120.5 million dollars (+268.6%)

Original ou neutre.texte: Original/Smooth nicotine pouch dollar sales increased from $11.1 million to $53.8 million (+386.5%)

Effet froid.texte: Clear/other cooling-flavored nicotine pouch dollar sales increased from $12.5 million to $19.8 million (+58.7%)

Menthol.texte: Menthol-flavored nicotine pouch dollar sales increased from $1.9 million to $6.0 million (+212.3%)
